categories.label: Core
categories.note: Display grouping only (spec §2.6) - never an assignable role value. Three leaves as of 2026-08-03 (distinguishing, bridging, anchoring), not two - anchoring is the cross-block cell the original four-leaf taxonomy never named: reaches nowhere (rho < 0.6), repelled by nothing (min(others) >= 0).

categories.label: Boundary (non-core)
categories.note: Display grouping only (spec §2.6) - never an assignable role value. The category name is 'boundary', not 'border' - confirmed against spec v2.0, correcting earlier front-end usage. Label string set by wordings ruling R4 (2026-08-08): 'Boundary (non-core)' exactly, including capitalisation and parentheses, wherever the display grouping appears; 'Core' is the other grouping. The formal rename is deferred post-Zurich at AD-NONCORE-RENAME-DEFERRED.

unresolved.note: UNRESOLVED (spec §2.6) is an error condition, not a role. As of the 2026-08-03 ratio-rule amendment plus the fifth-role ruling, the classification chain is exhaustive by construction for any stable, positively-anchored concept - UNRESOLVED should now be unreachable in practice. If it appears at all, that is a defect to report, not a normal outcome. A concept in this state has role: null in the result artefact and its concept_id appears in roles.unresolved_concept_ids. Must be surfaced as a prominent warning (spec §3.3), never a silent default.
